utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep — it’s still happening, just moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. I’ll send out the final details soon and let everyone know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll pass it along once you send them out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep things on schedule for the repair drive and see you by the garage this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Eli — thanks for keeping it on schedule. I’ll let you know right away if anything changes before this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn. I’ll be there by the garage this afternoon unless I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it got moved to Sunday at the community center — is there anything urgent left for me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what does the repair drive still need from me?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand, but nothing urgent has come up yet. Maybe check with Cleo about supplies at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve been mentioning it while I’m out, and I’ll keep spreading the word about the urgent fixes too. Hopefully we can get a few more names for the repair drive soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — I’m still keeping an eye on the supplies, and I’ll let you know right away if we start running low on anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word while I’m out, especially about the urgent fixes and getting a few more names.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules — I could still use a few more volunteers and any tools folks can spare. Saturday at the front porch, if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about volunteers and tools, and I’ll try to make it Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Jules. That means a lot — I’m hoping we can get enough hands together by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam, I’m setting up the repair drive on the front porch this Saturday—can you help?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help—just let me know what you need me to bring or do.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—please bring a toolbox, extension cord, and a couple of folding chairs. Could you also help set up the front porch tables Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Vik — I’m setting up the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I’m trying to work around the school schedule. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’d say let’s aim for mid-morning, maybe around 10, so folks can swing by after the school rush. I’ll keep reminding everyone about the repair drive and the volunteers, tools, and items we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 works for me — I’ll plan on that and keep it tied to the school schedule. Thanks for helping remind everyone about the repair drive and what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to sort out the logistics for Sunday at the community center—what do they still need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring whatever’s still missing—what do you need most at the community center on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m trying to pin down the basics first—do we still need tools most, or are there supplies we’re short on?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still a bit out of the loop, honestly—if there’s any update on what the repair drive still needs, I’m all ears.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, as far as I know it’s still happening. I’m a little behind on the details, though—what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking the repair drive spot—once it’s set up, I’ll pass along any changes right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — appreciate you keeping an eye on it. If anything changes, please let me know right away, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep everyone posted if the spot changes. For now, I’m still waiting on the exact setup location for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll swing by the garage this afternoon and let’s get everything ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey—I’ll have them set aside by the garage this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll check by the garage this afternoon and get things ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ve got the spare screwdriver and blue tape ready, and I’ll swing by when I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Bo — and just so I don’t forget, it’s at the community center on Sunday now, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, Sunday at the community center sounds right to me. I’ll pass along any more names if I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now, so I’m checking what still needs doing there. If you want, I can help sort out the remaining tasks.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve already been telling folks, and I can keep spreading the word this afternoon. Let me know what still needs doing at the community center, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn — that’d help a lot. I’m checking the list now, and I’ll let you know what’s still needed at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Cleo. Just a heads-up: the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, thanks for the update—I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know if we’re running low before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Cleo. That works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia. I’ll keep Saturday open and wait to hear what you still need most.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Actually, it moved to Sunday at the community center, so please keep that day open. I’m still trying to confirm what they need most before we bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll keep Sunday open for the community center and wait to hear what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now, isn’t it? I’m happy to help out, just remind me what needs fixing again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Right, we still need a few more names and some volunteers, plus small tools for the urgent fixes like wrenches or screwdrivers. I’ll keep mentioning it while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I can help gather names and I’ve got a screwdriver I can bring too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on—just moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll let you know if I hear what tools they still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks Tess. I’ll keep a few tools ready for Sunday and check back with you for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Gus—I’ll pass along anything I hear about what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Kira, are you able to help at the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening this Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, it’s still on this Saturday at the front porch. Can you help for a bit?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks for the update, Hana. I’ll plan for Sunday at the community center and wait to hear if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, Sunday at the community center still works, and I’ll let you know if anything changes. If you can keep asking for a few more names and mention the urgent fixes, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely—I’ll keep asking around for a few more names and mention the urgent fixes too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s still happening, just on Sunday at the community center now. I’ll send out the final list soon, and if you can bring a few basic tools and gloves, that would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll bring some basic tools and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Uli — that’s really helpful. I’ll be in touch soon with the final list and timing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks — I’d really appreciate that. We still need more volunteers, plus tools and a few fix-it items for Saturday at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about volunteers, tools, and fix-it items for Saturday at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — that helps a lot. If you hear of anyone who can bring a drill, tape, or extra hands, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it got moved to Sunday at the community center — is there anything still urgent I should know about?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for checking — yes, the main thing is still helping get word out, and I’ll confirm the time and place before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll help spread the word, and please let me know the confirmed time and place when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ve got the spare screwdriver and blue tape ready, and I’ll swing by when I can. If I hear of any more names for the repair drive, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — I’m still tracking the repair drive spot at the front porch this Saturday. If you hear of any change, just let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes. See you at the front porch Saturday.
